name: ollama_resource_controls

systemd_dropin.rationale: The safeguard writes a Linux systemd resource-control drop-in.

storage.rationale: Linux-only system configuration is verified by the safeguard file check.

description: Cap ollama.service memory and bias OOM killer toward it via a systemd drop-in, so an embeddings burst from any caller cannot exhaust host RAM

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.
